mechanical_binding_policy.late_binding: Private Rust names/layout are not specified by L0. They may not compare via a second algorithm, invent identities/events, compute expected values, inspect expected-output files, choose favorable branches, drop fields or run a fixture-simulated lifecycle.
mechanical_binding_policy.test_hooks: Where no return value exposes retention/lifecycle, cfg(test) hooks may record only transitions actually taken in the same productive algorithm, using frozen event fields and predeclared observation points. No new public product API, alternative test algorithm, runtime registry or changed production behavior. Verifier compares ordinary and instrumented path/configuration and requires actual callgraph reachability.
mechanical_binding_policy.final_gate: Verifier independently checks each binding body and real source/callgraph, exact compiled configuration and real test execution. The target must be the operation used by ordinary product execution, not a test-only imitation. Every frozen semantic clause remains mandatory. Unknown mapping, false-as-Unproven, missing field, incomplete hook or absent real target blocks closure. Any changed fixture/assertion/port meaning invalidates seal.
mechanical_binding_policy.capabilities: Oracle author does not gain candidate/baseline-source access; mechanical harness author remains within pinned supplement. Implementer writes only candidate bindings, not protected fixtures/predicates. Verifier alone judges bindings and outcomes. This contract grants no wider access.
mechanical_binding_policy.exhaustive_inventory: Before seal freeze a declarative baseline/L0 inventory of every Value/Content/Args/Selector/diagnostic variant and field, including approved new variants. Each leaf/category maps to a concrete independent test or a precisely specified exhaustive structural witness, never a few examples relabeled complete. Adapter author may publish baseline data/signature inventory to oracle author without granting source access.
